items.title: X-energy Lost 23% in a Month. Wedbush Sees 54% Upside From Here
items.summary: Key TakeawaysX-energy stock fell 23% in the past month as investors sold small-reactor stocks, Oklo and NuScale Power among them. The company’s own news was good: a joint development deal with American Electric Power and Amazon for a 960 MW plant in Indiana, and a finished NRC safety review of its Xe-100 reactor.
